neighbours.label: the preposition or word that introduces a person's area of work after a job or role phrase ('responsible for', 'positions in', 'working at')
fire: At the agency she was in charge of hiring and training new staff.
My first job was in customer support for a software company.
He worked for ten years as a nurse in the emergency ward.
In my role I am responsible for the budget of three departments.
She has held management positions in banking and insurance.
After college I took a job at a small publishing house.
The new manager will oversee operations in the Berlin office.
During the summer he worked in a hotel kitchen washing dishes.
quiet: At the zoo the storm was the reason for the closing of the park.
My first trip was in winter to a cabin in the mountains.
He waited for ten minutes at a bus stop in the rain.
In this story the wind is responsible for the broken window.
She has kept old letters in boxes and drawers at home.
After college I took a trip to a small village in Spain.
The new bridge will carry traffic in the city center.
During the summer he swam in a lake near his grandmother's house.

notes: Top: 'responsible for the artwork', 'positions in freight', 'working at Actorium, an acting school', 'Work in a cafe (not in a kitchen)'. Probe: job contexts 0.21-0.44, 'the river was responsible for flooding' 0.02. Near misses use the same prepositions outside a job context. The - pole is diligence / dedication to work (hard-working, dedication to duty).
